cells.tense: You are walking out of what no longer reaches you and toward what still does.
cells.ask: Say one thing out loud to the people who matter that you have been keeping as a thought, and let speaking it show you what is next.
cells.core: You are already making the move. Leaving behind what stopped carrying anything between you and the people who matter, turning toward the tie that still does. That takes some depth, to know the difference between the two. And because you can tell them apart, there is an invitation sitting underneath it.\nThe invitation is not to leave. It is to let what is alive in these connections feed the next thing. You have walked out of one room and you have not said what brought you here. That sentence, said to them, is what is missing. When you are at peace with leaving, leaving gets easy to announce, and the person still inside deserves to hear it from you. Say it plainly. The reply will show you which connection is actually yours to keep.
cells.sheetLine: Name the leaving, and let the next tie pick itself up from there.
cells.verb: walking toward what still connects, and letting what does not fall behind
cells.place: in the living tie between you and the people who matter to you

cells.tense: You are bracing for a future departure and reading it into people who are still here.
cells.ask: Tell one person what you see ending, without arguing for it, and let them answer without needing to agree.
cells.core: You have decided where the leaving goes, and you are walking the people close to you toward the door before they have packed. The deep sense that something is ending is real, and it is coming out as pressure. Arrangements made ahead, distance called in advance, a case being built for the ending before the ending is here.\nWhat is waiting under that is a clearing, not a plan. The structures that deserve to fall will fall when you say what you see and stop steering it. Tell one person what you have noticed. Let them disagree. The depth you actually have does not need them to agree; that is what makes it different from a decision. Sit with how that unsettles you before you settle anything.
cells.sheetLine: You are pushing the door open before you have reached it.
cells.verb: walking toward what still connects, and letting what does not fall behind
cells.place: in the living tie between you and the people who matter to you

cells.tense: There was a leaving that asked you to walk, and you are at the threshold a while now.
cells.ask: Pick one tie that has thinned and write, in two columns, what you gave it and what came back. Read the page once.
cells.core: Something went quiet and you did not mark it. The tie thinned, the direction was obvious, and you stayed where you were, close enough to answer and far enough not to feel it. That missing step is not cowardice. It is the habit of keeping a place in a connection whose meaning has run out.\nWhat brings the current back is not feeling more toward the people you have kept at arm's length. It is seeing the shape. The same pattern coming back, tie after tie, when what you carry is given and returned. Trace one of them, the most recent, on paper. What you put in one column and what you got in the other will tell you something nobody else has to sign off on. That reading is where the next leaving can start from.
cells.sheetLine: You are at a doorway you already crossed.
cells.verb: walking toward what still connects, and letting what does not fall behind
cells.place: in the living tie between you and the people who matter to you

cells.tense: You are already giving people the words that carry them across, and calling it nothing.
cells.ask: Name the one line you keep saying to people that has become how they see it, and tell them it started with you.
cells.core: Somewhere in the last months, one of your sentences stopped being yours and became theirs. They say it back to you, use it to steady themselves, pass it on. The transmission is running. You have not called it what it is. You would say you were just talking, or that they found it themselves, or that it is not a big thing.\nYou can carry that quiet differently. It does not need a stage. One person who took one line should know where it came from. Not for credit. For the next thing, because when you can see the line as yours you stop leaving the deepest material sitting in other people's hands to make a home. Sharing what matters is not self-important. It is delivery.
cells.sheetLine: The words people carry from you are yours.
cells.verb: walking toward what still connects, and letting what does not fall behind
cells.place: in the living tie between you and the people who matter to you

attempts.check: The record supports only one mechanism for this status: what this balance is free to feed next. I cannot claim the person already feeds it, has fed it, or knows where the next depth is — the record stops at the invitation. A reader could reasonably say they do reach for their people and it still goes wrong; the ask survives that, because naming which tie has gone shallow is useful even when the answer is none. The sentence serving me rather than them is 'You know which one' — I am borrowing a certainty the record does not give me, so the cell says what they can check instead.
